title: fix(plugin-detail): a record:details node with no sections and no fields draws the object's highlightFields (objectui#12433)
body:
Fixes #12433

Clause-②: no

## What changed

A `record:details` node that authors neither `sections` nor `fields` now draws the object's `highlightFields`. `@objectstack/spec` declares this fallback on `RecordDetailsProps` ("omitting it falls back to the object's `highlightFields` (the old `auto`)"; the `fields` describe says "overrides highlightFields"), and this block's own registry `inputs` already published both sentences. Before this change the renderer handed `DetailView` no body at all: one empty `space-y-6` div.

- **When it runs:** only when the node authors neither key. An authored `sections` or `fields`, an empty one included, is the body exactly as before.
- **Which path the list takes:** the authored-`fields` path. That is the field-security fold (`enforceFieldSecurity` / `redactFields`), the label ladder, and the dedupe against the mounted `record:highlights` strip (`HighlightFieldsContext`) and the page H1.
- **An emptied list:** a list the fold empties stays empty. Nothing is derived in its place.
- **No `highlightFields`:** an object that declares none keeps today's empty body. The spec names no further fallback, so none is invented; the report carries this as an open question.

No type, prop or export changes, and the renderer's imports are unchanged. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

Files: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` (the body-list read only), the new pin file `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.highlightFieldsFallback-12433.test.tsx`, and `.changeset/12433-record-details-highlight-fallback.md`.

## Measurements

- **A1, before any change (`main` 6843f7599):** the new pin file ran 8 failed / 5 passed. The failing DOM was the `record:details` div holding one empty `space-y-6` div.
- **A2, the served `sys_approval_request_detail` Details tab on the real `RecordDetailView`:** measured with a scratch copy of the console's served-page harness (`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage.test.tsx`), never committed and then deleted.
  - Before (the fallback ablated): the tab panel holds the `record:details` node with an empty body.
  - After: exactly one row, `Record ID`, drawn by the host's record-pointer card (`data-record-preview`). The harness's adapter double serves no `invoice` row, so the card shows its unreadable state ("This record cannot be opened"); with a real target it is the target-record card.
  - The strip's six fields are not repeated in the tab, and no other request field is drawn. `payload_json` and `node_config_json` never reach the tab.
- **A3:** `RecordDetailsProps` names `highlightFields` and nothing further, and the object's `highlightFields` describe names no detail-body fallback. The empty case is kept and pinned.
- **A4:** an FLS-refused highlight field is not drawn, a redacted one is not drawn, and a fully redacted list stays empty. All three are pinned.
- **A5:** see the census in Acceptance notes. The runtime default page passes explicit sections. Two Studio callers of `buildDefaultPageSchema` do not.

## Tests (all at head 9726530a69)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: Test Files 271 passed, 1 skipped (272); Tests 2627 passed, 14 skipped (2641). Lock verdict: command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the app-shell `RecordDetailView*` suites (all 58), `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource*`, and the metadata-admin `PagePreview*`, `page-preview-record-type-10482`, `palette-discussion-alias` and `dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3` suites: Test Files 71 passed (71); Tests 532 passed (532). Lock verdict: command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFiles` confirms the new pin file is in the test program.
- New pins, 13 cases:
  - a bare node draws `highlightFields` in declared order, with declared labels;
  - the H1 dedupe applies;
  - a mounted strip's fields are not repeated;
  - CONTROL: authored `sections`, authored `fields`, and authored empty `fields: []` / `sections: []`;
  - the `enforceFieldSecurity` and `redactFields` cases, and a fold-emptied list stays empty;
  - an object with no `highlightFields` stays empty, with a lit control;
  - the served page's shape: the body draws exactly the `record_id` pointer pair `{ objectName: 'invoice', recordId: 'inv_1' }`, and never the raw JSON columns.

## Ablations

Predictions were written before each run. Each leg ran through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor went 1 to 0 and the restore blob equalled HEAD, with `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `src` through the root vitest aliases, so there is no `dist` leg.

- **AB1, the fallback dropped** (the `highlightFields` read replaced by `undefined`): predicted 8 red / 5 green; measured 8 failed / 5 passed.
- **AB2, the block fold skipped for the top-level list:** predicted that the `redactFields` and fold-emptied cases go red and the `enforceFieldSecurity` case stays green, because `DetailView`'s own field-read gate drops that row too. Measured 2 failed / 11 passed. The FLS case therefore holds the outcome, and the redact case is the one that discriminates the block's fold. The test file says so beside the case.

## Gates (local, exit codes captured before any pipe, at 9726530a69)

- Exit 0, each printing its own pass line: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`.
- eslint on the two touched TS files: 0 errors. The renderer carries one `no-explicit-any` warning fewer than base, because the authored `fields` read lost its cast.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Not run: `check:eager-closure`, because the renderer's imports did not change. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **A5 census, authored pages.**
  - objectstack (`packages/**`, `examples/**`): 5 authored `record:details` nodes. 1 is bare, the served `sys_approval_request_detail`. The other 4 author `sections`: showcase project-detail, settings and task-detail, and platform-objects sys-user.
  - The published skill `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` shows a bare node in its invoice print-page example.
  - objectui apps, examples and fixtures: 0 authored pages. The one bare node is the console served-page test, a copy of the served page.
- **A5 census, producers of a bare node at runtime, in objectui.**
  - The Studio page designer's add-block inserts `{ type }` (`PageBlockCanvas` `addBlock`).
  - `buildDefaultPageSchema` called without `sections` emits a node with no `sections` for an object with no `fieldGroups` (`resolveDetailSections` returns undefined). Two callers do this: the Studio page-create seed (`anchors.ts` `createSeed`) and the Studio slotted-page preview (`PagePreview`).
  - The runtime default page composes with `synthParts.sections` (`RecordDetailView`), so it is unaffected.
- **Observation, read-only and not filed:** `resolveDetailSections`' doc says the no-groups case "falls back to its flat layout". The node now draws `highlightFields`. The Studio slotted preview therefore shows the highlight fields where the runtime default page shows the full field split, for an object with no `fieldGroups`; before this change the preview's body was empty. Not reproduced in a browser.
- **Harness observation, read-only:** in the console served-page harness the `Record ID` row offers inline edit, because that harness's object definition is abridged. The served `sys_approval_request` is `managedBy: 'engine-owned'` with no `userActions`, so the record-edit affordance resolves closed there. Not measured.
- **Known red:** objectui#12422 (the `plugin-list` type-check build-order race when `plugin-detail` rebuilds in the same run) may show on this PR. It is not addressed here; seat 2 holds it.
